subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is true about veteran nuclear scientist Rajagopala Chidambaram, who recently passed away?

options.text: He played a pivotal role in India’s nuclear tests in 1975 and 1998.
He served as the Director-General of ISRO.
He passed away at AIIMS Hospital in New Delhi.
He was associated with the development of India's first geo-stationary satellite.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He played a pivotal role in India’s nuclear tests in 1975 and 1998.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Veteran nuclear scientist Rajagopala Chidambaram passed away on January 4, 2025, at the age of 88.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Chidambaram was instrumental in India’s nuclear tests of 1974 (Smiling Buddha) and 1998 (Pokhran-II).**
 
• **He was associated with India’s nuclear weapons program.**
 
• **He passed away at Jaslok Hospital in Mumbai.**
 
• **He was a distinguished scientist contributing significantly to India’s atomic energy sector.**
 
• He served as Principal Scientific Adviser (2001–2018), chaired the Atomic Energy Commission, and was pivotal in shaping India's nuclear and technological capabilities.
 
• He was honored with Padma Shri (1975) & Padma Vibhushan (1999).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Smiling Buddha (1974)__

 __
 
• India’s first nuclear test conducted under the leadership of scientists like Raja Ramanna and supported by Dr. Chidambaram.
 
 
 
• Pokhran-II (1998)__
 
 
• A series of five nuclear bomb tests conducted during Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee’s tenure.
